name: heat_pump_basic_tespy
title: Basic heat pump (TESPy tutorial)
summary: Single-stage R134a vapour-compression heat pump after the TESPy basic tutorial: evaporator and condenser with 2 % pressure drop each, constant-efficiency compressor, isenthalpic valve; delivers a prescribed condenser heat output with a COP parametric study.

authors: Francesco Witte (TESPy lead developer) and the TESPy contributors

verification.reference: TESPy tutorial heat_pump.py run from the local snapshot (commit 19425523) in a throw-away venv (Python 3.11, CoolProp 8.0.0): base case, 3 specification variants (fixed mass flow, fixed pressure ratio, fixed discharge temperature) and 3 sweep spot-checks
verification.notes: Base case and fixed-m / fixed-pr variants agree to <= 2.4e-13; discharge-T variant to 5.8e-09; sweep end points to <= 8e-09. Same CoolProp EOS on both sides.

CoolSolve examples/refrigeration2.eescode (R22 heat pump, G-refrig group)
